topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Been a while since I last saw young Thomas, but he's never forgotten the lessons we shared. Came into the village market the other day, and there he was, waiting for me. He'd grown into a fine young man, straight and tall, like a good stalk of grain ready for the harvest. In his hands, a basket wrapped in a cloth, old hands trembling with excitement when he handed it to me. Lifted the cloth, and there lay a loaf of bread, home-baked, and a small book of psalms. The bread, warm and yeasty, was a reminder of simpler, better days. The book, with its leather binding and worn pages, was a gift for the soul. He bowed his head, said a few words, and then was off, back to his ways. I stood there, my heart full, the village bustling around me, but all I could think was of the lessons returned, the cycle complete, life as it should be.
